name: L10 frozen V5 portal witness transfer to unique-building LSAA Vienna Development
question: Does the frozen SEVN V5 portal-private PP-OCRv6 medium witness retain useful exact-text and target-door binding performance on provider-, city-, and selected-building-disjoint LSAA Vienna facades while abstaining on deterministic wrong-address controls?

cohort.selected_building_rule: All 48 selected OSM buildings, facade members, and panorama IDs are unique across Development and confirmation holdout.
cohort.confirmation_holdout: No confirmation facade pixel may be materialized or reviewed during this Development run.

transfer_contract.algorithm: Reuse V5 inference byte-for-byte: frozen PP-OCRv6 small multiscale baseline, frozen portal masks and topology, and frozen PP-OCRv6 medium portal-private unique-witness abstention branch.
transfer_contract.positive: Run the true OSM numeric mission. Score any selected mask only after inference against the single official LSAA door box.
transfer_contract.counterfactual: Run the deterministic distinct rotated house number on the identical pixels. Any emitted binding is a false binding; abstention is correct.
transfer_contract.visible_text_denominator: Use only the ten pre-inference human-legible exact-token annotations. OSM metadata is not visible-text truth.
transfer_contract.portal_oracle: Report whether any runtime portal candidate overlaps the official LSAA door, but never use evaluator boxes to select, rerank, or modify a runtime proposal.

execution_rule: Freeze evaluator, source, metadata truth, human pixel truth, materialization hashes, unchanged V5 implementation and protocol, gates, and control semantics before inference. Run one output-bearing Development invocation. Do not inspect confirmation pixels or claim confirmation authority.
claim_boundary: A pass is provider-, city-, and selected-building-disjoint LSAA Development evidence for pixel-level lexical and mask-door binding transfer under this curated single-door cohort. It is not a fresh confirmation result and does not establish address-to-door ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety.
non_claims: LSAA official single-door boxes are evaluator annotations and do not enter inference.
Visible address text elsewhere on the same facade is lexical evidence only and is not proof that it owns the official door.
The cohort is quality-filtered, one-official-door, raw-numeric-address Vienna data; it is not a natural prevalence estimate.
A failed gate closes only this unchanged transfer attempt. It leaves UNKNOWN as unknown and may motivate a new Development mechanism without opening the holdout.
